basic_details.job_title: MGU Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Research Assistant and Field Investigator Posts
basic_details.short_information: Mahatma Gandhi University (MGU) has released the official Research Assistant and Field Investigator Notification 2026 at https://www.mgu.ac.in/. A total of 3 vacancies have been announced under the MGU Research Assistant and Field Investigator Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates with a Postgraduate degree in Social Sciences/ Humanities (minimum 55% marks) with NET/ M.Phil./ Ph.D. for Research Assistant, or a Postgraduate degree in Social Sciences/Humanities with a minimum of 55% marks for Field Investigator can apply through email up to 10 August 2026. content_sections.heading: MGU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the MGU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download MGU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: MGU Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available – 1 for Research Assistant and 2 for Field Investigator.

content_sections.heading: MGU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Post Graduate in Social Sciences/Humanities (55% minimum) with NET/ M.Phil./ Ph.D. Desirable: Expertise in studies on kinship and rituals. Field Investigator: Post Graduate in Social Sciences/Humanities with minimum 55% marks. Desirable: Familiarity with Studies on kinship and rituals.

content_sections.heading: MGU Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Rs. 37,000/- p.m. Field Investigator: Rs. 20,000/- p.m.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MGU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the MGU Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts is 10-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Research Assistant position, candidates must have a Post Graduate degree in Social Sciences/Humanities with a minimum of 55% marks, along with NET, M.Phil., or Ph.D. qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Field Investigator position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in this MGU recruitment?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University is recruiting for a total of 3 posts, which include 1 Research Assistant and 2 Field Investigator positions.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this MGU recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for these positions through email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address provided.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for MGU Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will involve shortlisting of applications followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Mahatma Gandhi University located?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University is located in Kottayam, Kerala, with the pincode 686041.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age limit relaxations for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age limits or relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification for this information.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with their application.
